rows.v: 8%、7%、20% 是三类材料在卷面上的权重，不是每道题的报道分。
rows.src: C1 CET笔试结构表；C3 分数解释

body.p: 长对话和听力篇章的词数指一段或一篇的长度。讲话、报道、讲座的约 1200 词是三篇的合计。
一段长对话 280—320 词，一篇听力篇章 240—260 词。题量按类计算：长对话两段共 8 题，听力篇章两篇共 7 题。
30 分钟是整个听力部分的时间，三类材料共用。每段录音只播放 1 遍。
三类材料的卷面比例合计为 35%，其中讲话、报道、讲座占 20%，比例最高。报道分要经过等值和常模转换，所以不能按比例算出一道题的固定分值。

items.stem: Which description matches the conversation materials?
options: Two recordings of 280–320 words each.
Two recordings of 240–260 words each.
Three recordings totaling about 1,200 words.
Three recordings of 280–320 words each.
items.why: 长对话 2 段，每段 280—320 词，即第一项。240—260 词是听力篇章的长度。

items.stem: How are the seven passage questions distributed by material type?
options: They accompany the two conversations.
They accompany three talks or reports.
They accompany two listening passages.
They accompany all listening materials.
items.why: 听力篇章 2 篇，共 7 题，即第三项。长对话是 8 题，讲话、报道、讲座是 10 题。

options: The length of each of the three talks, reports or lectures.
The combined length of the two conversations and two passages.
The length of each conversation together with its questions.
The combined length of the three talks, reports or lectures.
items.why: 约 1200 词是讲话、报道、讲座三篇的合计长度，即第四项。第一项把合计当成了单篇。

items.stem: Which statement correctly combines time and playback?
options: Each conversation takes 30 minutes; recordings play once.
The listening section takes 30 minutes; recordings play once.
The listening section takes 30 minutes; recordings play twice.
Each passage takes 30 minutes; recordings play twice.
items.why: 30 分钟是整个听力部分的时间，录音播放 1 遍，即第二项。

items.stem: Which sequence gives the paper weights for conversations, passages, and talks respectively?
items.why: 长对话、听力篇章、讲话报道讲座依次占全卷 8%、7%、20%，即第一项。

items.stem: How should the listening percentages be interpreted?
options: As reported points awarded unchanged for each correct answer.
As percentages of the 30 minutes assigned to each recording.
As paper weights, rather than fixed reported points per question.
As proportions of words assigned to the three material types.
items.why: 依据是分数解释：报道分要经过等值和常模转换。8%、7%、20% 是卷面权重，第三项与此相符。
